standard_prerequisites.name: The sheaf of ideals generated by finitely many local functions, and the interpretation of the sum of the tensor products of those functions with the given sections as a section of the tensor product with the ideal sheaf
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Used at the start of the counted proof (source lines 2993-2996)
standard_prerequisites.use: Turns the hypothesis that the displayed complex is a complex into a relation in a tensor product.

standard_prerequisites.name: The injectivity of the maps obtained by tensoring with a flat module, and the description of the tensor product of the ideal sheaf with a flat module by generators and relations
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Used inside the counted proof (source lines 2996-3004), the last step by a cross-chapter pointer
standard_prerequisites.use: Lifts the vanishing of the section of the tensor product to an explicit relation between the local functions and the local sections.

core_obligations: Translate to a tensor product: the proof forms the ideal sheaf generated by the local functions and identifies the sum of the tensor products of the functions with the sections as a local section of the tensor product of that ideal sheaf with the module, which maps to zero (proof lines 2993-2996)
Use flatness: since the module is flat the map from the tensor product with the ideal sheaf into the module is injective, so that section is already zero (proof lines 2996-2999)

Pass to the presheaf and unwind: the tensor product with a sheaf of ideals is the sheafification of the presheaf tensor product, so on a smaller neighbourhood the section vanishes in the tensor product of the sections, and unwinding the relations there produces the required functions and sections giving the factorisation (proof lines 3000-3006)
proof_roadmap: 令 I 为由 f_1,…,f_n 生成的理想层；则 ∑ f_i ⊗ s_i 是 I ⊗_{O_U} F|_U 的截面且映到 F|_U 中为 0。因 F 平坦，I ⊗ F → F 单射，故该截面本身为 0。
I ⊗ F 是预层张量的层化，故在 x 的某邻域 V 上 ∑ f_i|_V ⊗ s_i|_V 在 I(V) ⊗_{O(V)} F(V) 中为 0；由跨章的关系式引理展开定义即得 a_{ij} 使 ∑ a_{ij}f_i = 0 且 s_i = ∑ a_{ij}t_j。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement gives the local criterion for a map from the structure sheaf into a finite direct sum of the structure sheaf followed by a surjection onto a flat module to factor through a free module with the composite killing the first map (author lemma at source lines 2972-2990, label lemma-flat-eq). The proof (source lines 2992-3007) turns the composition being zero into the vanishing of a section of the tensor product of the ideal sheaf generated by the given functions with the module, uses the injectivity of that tensor product map coming from flatness, and then sheafifies and unwinds the relation to produce the required factorisation (proof lines 2993-3006). The passage through the tensor product with the ideal sheaf is the content. H2.
